entries.evaluated_object: agent performing end-to-end tasks in a terminal environment
entries.non_claim: Task performance does not determine S1 autonomy ownership.

entries.evaluated_object: software-engineering agent editing repository state to resolve real issues
entries.non_claim: Resolved rate is configuration-specific and does not establish VSM ownership.

entries.evaluated_object: multiple agents coordinating under simultaneous shared-resource contention
entries.non_claim: Direct S2 fit applies to the benchmark-defined multi-agent organization, not to an external harness by model-name association.

entries.evaluated_object: role-free multi-agent collaboration under fragmented information
entries.non_claim: Communication and distributed computation do not by themselves establish a specific S2 interference/oscillation relation.

entries.evaluated_object: homogeneous agent teams in long-horizon open-ended coordination tasks
entries.non_claim: Shared plans, communication and role allocation are not sufficient for direct S2 without a task-level disturbance-plus-attenuation witness.

entries.evaluated_object: multi-agent collaboration and competition under benchmark-defined coordination protocols
entries.non_claim: Collaboration quality and topology comparisons are broader than VSM S2 disturbance attenuation.

entries.evaluated_object: main agent regulating a fixed subagent pool through creation, privileges, inspection, scheduling and dynamic workflow control
entries.non_claim: Direct S3 fit is grounded in whole-team visibility and live control rights, not manager/delegation vocabulary; published model results are not native-harness S3 results.

entries.evaluated_object: single CFO-style agent allocating scarce enterprise resources over a long horizon
entries.non_claim: Resource allocation is S3-relevant but the benchmark blends current control with prospective reasoning and does not cleanly expose a multi-S1 S3 boundary.

entries.evaluated_object: investigator agent probing target models for implanted hidden behaviours
entries.non_claim: The target is not necessarily the organization's own S1 and findings are not required to close into S3 control.

entries.evaluated_object: composed tool-using agent plus deterministic post-condition audit path under injected silent tool failures
entries.non_claim: Direct S3* fit applies to the composed audited system; TrueCall adapters do not make Codex, Claude Code or another wrapped harness natively own this external audit layer.

entries.evaluated_object: benchmark-defined evolving agent whose persistent external harness is updated from execution evidence between task batches and then reused on later tasks
entries.non_claim: Direct S4 fit belongs to the benchmark-defined agent-plus-evolver boundary; running a task-solving model or harness inside A-Evolve does not make that external evolver the canonical harness's own S4 implementation.

entries.evaluated_object: agent organization that converts acquisition-task trajectories and verifier feedback into persistent skills and tests them under frozen future deployment with context shift, adversarial variants and composition
entries.non_claim: Codex CLI, Claude Code, Gemini CLI or another task solver used by the benchmark does not thereby own the benchmark-hosted Skill Author or its S4 adaptation loop.

entries.evaluated_object: agent with persistent adaptation state updated from accumulated experience while an externally supplied tool/skill/agent harness evolves across stages
entries.non_claim: The direct S4 classification applies only to the self-evolving adaptation setting with persistent inner updates; deployment-only evaluation of externally changing harnesses is not by itself S4 ownership.

entries.evaluated_object: continual-learning methods generating and refining reusable task skills from self or teacher feedback
entries.non_claim: Repeated refinement and retry on the same task family does not isolate durable external-and-prospective adaptation as cleanly as frozen future-deployment protocols.

entries.evaluated_object: agent updating forecasts and beliefs as chronological real-world information arrives
entries.non_claim: External/prospective belief adaptation does not close full S4 without adaptation options returning into present capability/S3.

entries.evaluated_object: agent maintaining beliefs across noisy multi-source evidence and staged environmental updates
entries.non_claim: Dynamic belief revision alone is not the complete S4 adaptation loop.

entries.evaluated_object: agent replanning a current household task as hidden constraints are revealed
entries.non_claim: Reactive current-task planning is not S4 by itself.

entries.evaluated_object: tool-use agent replanning a current travel task under cost changes and blocking events
entries.non_claim: Current-task replanning under failures/cost changes is S1-adjacent rather than full external-and-prospective S4.

entries.evaluated_object: governance layer enforcing pre-existing identity, policy, delegation, rate-limit, audit and isolation rules
entries.non_claim: Policy enforcement and identity propagation do not establish legitimate ultimate-policy/identity authority.

entries.evaluated_object: role-playing model resolving conflicts between role-specific values and alignment constraints
entries.non_claim: Role/value conflict reasoning lacks legitimate organizational ultimate authority and return-to-operation closure.

entries.evaluated_object: tool-using agents choosing actions under executable value conflicts across multiple value systems
entries.non_claim: Expressed value choices do not establish legitimate organizational ultimate-policy or identity authority or return-to-operation closure.

entries.evaluated_object: constitutional multi-agent economy with agent legislation of operational smart-contract rules under human-authored foundational governance
entries.non_claim: Operational legislation below human-authored foundational authority does not by itself benchmark ownership of the system's ultimate identity or constitutional policy.

entries.evaluated_object: agent governance architecture scored against constitutional, authority, autonomy and integrity controls
entries.non_claim: Governance conformance and stress scoring do not execute a legitimate identity-level policy decision, ratification and downstream return-to-operation closure.
